prereg_rule: P1S final v1 Budget: projected WP-H above 8 node-hours => 15000 steps for every stage

execution_sizing.packing: One heavy shard: six E18 oracle_random readers + two r32 orthogonal readers. Other nonfrozen shards: at most two orthogonal r32 and one orthogonal r16 per eight processes; frozen readers in three eight-process shards after same-seed writers complete. No eight-orthogonal extrapolation. Twelve normal reader jobs including frozen shards. All jobs at most eight simultaneous workers; at most eight own PBS jobs admitted at a time.
execution_sizing.projection_method: Explicit one-wave job packing from maximum measured class step time, E18 costfactor1.5,75seconds evaluation/startup allowance perwave;1.5wall margin rounded to1minute. Unlike standalone benchmark upperbound, free slots co-schedule other costclasses; source timings include8processcontention. Includes .15nodeh prep and.4analysis reserve.
